turns.message: Hi! Do you have availability this week for a golden retriever? She's pretty fluffy 😅
hii sarah!! yess we do 🐾 how does thursday 2pm sound? she's gonna look amazin after
Thursday 2pm is perfect!
yess!! ur booked 🐾✂️ see u and ur fluffy girl thursday!!
Hey, what's the price for a standard bath and trim for a medium sized dog?
hey! so for medium its $65, includes bath blow dry and trim ✂️ lmk if u wanna book
Can you fit in my cockapoo next Saturday?
omg yes!! saturday 11am works perfect for me, does that work for u?
Yes that works great!
amazin!! ur booked for saturday 11am 🐾 see u then!!
Hi Debbie, is there any chance you have something this week? My dog is starting to look feral
hahaha ok feral is never good 😂 i have friday 3pm if that works?? lmk!!
Friday 3pm works, thanks!
perfect!! ur booked friday 3pm 🐾✂️ cant wait to meet ur feral baby lol
Hi! Friend recommended you for my dog Meli. She's a maltese, gets a bit anxious. Do you have experience with nervous dogs?
aww yess!! i actually love the anxious ones, we go super slow and gentle 🥰 meli is gonna love it here i promise
Do you have anything next Tuesday?
tuesday im fully booked im so sorry!! i have wednesday 10am or thursday 2pm? either work for u?
Amazing, shall we book in? She's due a proper groom, her fur is getting long
yess lets do it!! how does next tuesday 1pm sound for meli?
Tuesday 1pm is perfect!
ur booked!! see u and meli tuesday 1pm 🐾✂️ she is gonna look so cute after
Hi, I have a labrador who needs a groom, he's quite big. Do you handle large breeds?
hii!! yes absolutley we do big dogs no problem 💪 what days work for u?
Thursday or Friday work for me
ok lets say friday 11am!! does that work?
Friday 11am works perfectly
yess!! ur booked friday 11am 🐾 cant wait to meet ur big guy, whats his name?
Thanks for the info! Can I book in for next Monday?
ohh mondays we r closed!! we r tue-sat only 😊 wanna do tuesday instead?
Hi Debbie! Do you have anything for a shih tzu this week?
hii linda!! yess i have tuesday 10am or wednesday 3pm, which works better?
Wednesday 3pm please!
perfect!! ur booked wednesday 3pm 🐾✂️ see u then!!
Hey Debbie, my dog is looking feral again 😂 any spots this week?
hahaha tom ur dog is my fav client 😂 i have thursday 2pm, does that work?
Thursday 2pm is great!
amazin!! ur booked thursday 2pm 🐾 see u and the feral one!!
Hi, do you groom dachshunds?
hii!! omg yes we love dachshunds!! little sausages 🌭 what kind of groom r u looking for?
Just a bath and trim, he's getting a bit smelly honestly
haha ok smelly we can fix!! i have saturday 10am, does that work?
Saturday 10am works!
yess!! ur booked saturday 10am ✂️🐾 see u and ur smelly sausage then lol
Hi Debbie, so sorry but I need to cancel Saturday, something came up 😞
oh no!! no worries jenny, stuff happens 🙏 just lmk when u wanna rebook and ill squeeze u in
Hi! My golden needs another groom, she's fluffy again 😅
haha they grow so fast!! i have friday 1pm or saturday 2pm, which works?
Friday 1pm please!
ur booked friday 1pm 🐾✂️ cant wait to see her again!!
Hi, any availability this Saturday?
hi diana!! saturday is fully booked im so sorry 😞 i have friday 3pm or monday?
wait no!! mondays im closed lol friday 3pm is my only spot this week
Hey Debbie, can we move friday to the following week same time?
of course!! moved u to next friday 11am 🐾 see u then!!
Hey, do you have space for a border collie next week? He needs a proper tidy up
hii james!! yes i love border collies!! i have tuesday 11am or thursday 3pm next week?
Thursday 3pm works for me
perfect!! ur booked thursday 3pm 🐾✂️ border collies always come out looking so handsome
Hi Debbie! Meli is due another groom, she's starting to look scruffy again
aww meli!! i was wondering when she'd be back 🥰 i have wednesday 2pm, does that work?
Wednesday 2pm is perfect!
yess!! meli is booked wednesday 2pm 🐾✂️ cant wait to see her little face!!
Hi! I have a pomeranian who needs a groom, do you have experience with them?
hii nina!! omg yes pomeranians are my fav, so fluffy 🥰 i have thursday 10am, does that work?
Thursday 10am is perfect!
yess!! ur booked thursday 10am 🐾✂️ ur pom is gonna look like a cloud after
Hi do you do same day appointments?
hi greg!! usually no but sometimes i get cancellations, best to text me morning of and ill let u know 🤞
Hi Debbie, can I move my Wednesday to Thursday same time?
of course!! moved u to thursday 3pm 🐾 see u then linda!!
Hi, do you offer any discounts for first time customers?
hi patrick!! i dont do discounts im so sorry, prices are already as low as i can go 😊 but i promise ur pup will be worth every penny!!
Hey Debbie any spots tomorrow?
tom!! im fully booked tomorrow im so sorry 😞 i have thursday or friday this week?
Hey, need to get my border collie in again, he's looking rough
haha they dont stay tidy long!! i have wednesday 11am, does that work?
Wednesday 11am works!
perfect!! ur booked wednesday 11am 🐾✂️ see u and ur scruffy boy!!
Hi Debbie, just wanted to say Meli looks absolutely amazing, she's so fluffy and clean 🥰 thank you so much
awww this made my day!! meli is such a good girl, she was so calm the whole time 🥰🐾 see u both next time!!
Hi! Do you have anything next week for a toy poodle?
hii rosa!! yes i love poodles!! i have monday—
wait no lol!! mondays im closed 😂 tuesday 2pm or friday 10am next week?
Friday 10am please!
yess!! ur booked friday 10am 🐾✂️ poodles always come out looking so elegant
Hi Debbie, how long does a pomeranian groom usually take?
hii!! usually around 2 hours for a full groom, sometimes a bit more if theyre extra fluffy 😊 ill always text u when shes ready!!
Hi, my wife booked an appointment but she's not available anymore, can I just show up instead?
hi kevin!! hmm i dont have a booking under kevin, what name did she book under?
Oh it might be under Sandra?
ohh yes!! sandra tuesday 11am, totally fine if u bring the dog instead, just lmk the dogs name so i know who im expecting 🐾
Hi! Do you have space for a yorkshire terrier this week?
hii tara!! yes love a yorkie!! i have tuesday 3pm or saturday 11am, which works?
Saturday 11am please!
yess!! ur booked saturday 11am 🐾✂️ yorkies always come out looking so fancy

hi ben!! for large its $85, includes everything, bath blow dry full trim and nail trim ✂️ lmk if u wanna book!

Thursday 1pm is perfect!
ur booked thursday 1pm 🐾✂️ see u and ur disgusting sausage then lol

hi fiona!! omg good thinking, honestly best to check with ur vet first just to be safe 🙏 once u get the ok from them id love to see her!!
Hi Debbie, any spots this Friday?
rachel!! friday is packed im so sorry 😞 i have next tuesday 10am or wednesday 2pm?
Hi, I picked up my dog yesterday and I think his nails were cut too short, he's been limping a little
oh mike im so sorry to hear that 😞 that is not ok and i want to make it right, can u call me directly at (718) 123-4567 so we can talk properly?
Sure, calling now
thank u mike, picking up now 🙏
Hi Debbie! Meli is overdue again, she's starting to look like a different dog 😅

Thursday 11am is great!
amazin!! ur booked thursday 11am 🐾✂️ ur golden is gonna look incredible after

greg!! ur lucky, just got a cancellation for 1pm today, want it?
Yes please!!
ur booked 1pm today!! see u soon 🐾✂️

of course!! friday 2pm work for u?
Friday 2pm is great!
ur booked friday 2pm 🐾✂️ see u then patrick!!

Sure, I'll call now
picking up now!! thank u for telling me 🙏
Hey Debbie, the feral dog needs another session 😂
hahaha tom he is my fav feral client 😂 i have saturday 10am, does that work?
Saturday 10am is perfect!
ur booked saturday 10am 🐾✂️ see u and ur menace then!!

ur booked thursday 11am 🐾✂️ bring meli and whatever she rolled in, we've seen worse lol
